Proposals.Development: Adrian signs the consent forms for the experimental-medicine program and receives his first payment, establishing his legal commitment to the trial and securing the immediate financial means required for his survival, though he has not yet completed his first daily testing session.
Proposals.Evidence: Adrian signed his name on the signature line. His handwriting was shakier than usual. He signed again on the next page, and the next, and the next, until he'd initialed every clause and signed every required line.
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: Adrian has signed the consent forms and received his first payment, but he has not yet completed his first daily testing session. He is now legally bound to the trial and must navigate the initial days of the routine, which will be the context for the catastrophic accident.
Proposals.ProposedNextMilestone: Adrian completes his first daily testing session, establishing the routine and the physical/psychological toll of the trial, while navigating the early stages of the program.
